description: This file defines a set of template classes for proxy objects, including reference counting, container management, and queue mechanisms within the WPEFramework Core namespace. It implements proxy services, proxy objects, proxy types, and various container classes such as list, queue, map, and pool, with thread safety considerations and custom memory management.

classes.name: ProxyService
classes.description: A template class providing reference counting, memory management, and lifecycle control for proxy objects, with thread-safe AddRef and Release methods, custom new/delete operators, and optional initialization/deinitialization hooks.

classes.name: ProxyObject
classes.description: A class inheriting from ProxyService and IReferenceCounted, representing a reference-counted object that can be managed via proxies.

classes.name: ProxyType
classes.description: A smart pointer-like class managing the lifetime of proxy objects, supporting creation, reference counting, and type casting.

classes.name: ProxyList
classes.description: A thread-safe list container for proxy objects, supporting dynamic resizing, add, remove, and access operations.

classes.name: ProxyQueue
classes.description: A thread-safe producer-consumer queue for proxy objects, with support for blocking insert/extract, enabling/disabling, and state management.

classes.name: ProxyContainerType
classes.description: A template class for container elements that manage parent-child relationships, reference counting, and lifecycle notifications.

classes.name: ProxyPoolType
classes.description: A pool managing pre-allocated proxy elements, supporting object reuse, thread-safe element acquisition and return, and cleanup.

classes.name: ProxyMapType
classes.description: A thread-safe map container for proxy objects keyed by a custom key type, supporting instance creation, lookup, iteration, and cleanup.

classes.name: ProxyListType
classes.description: A thread-safe list container for proxy elements, supporting object instantiation, cleanup, and notification.

classes.name: IProxyContainerElement
classes.description: An interface for container elements that can be unlinked and notify parent containers.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Increments the reference count of the object in a thread-safe manner.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements the reference count and deletes the object if count reaches zero.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate proxy objects with optional initial arguments.

methods.name: Destroy
methods.description: Explicitly destroys the proxy object, releasing resources.

methods.name: Notify
methods.description: Notifies parent containers of object lifecycle events, such as unlinked or returned to pool.
